narratives.Description: rfc(intake,design-critique): set-level bind does not change ingest — sisters mint harvest xbriefs and superseded threads stay blocked
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

A **set-level** design-critique bind records a portfolio on one anchor thread. `issue:ingest` still treats every GitHub number as its own story and prefers the **issue body**. Bound sisters either mint the original harvest xbrief (`not-in-arc`) or refuse (`missing-record` on a superseded single-issue motion). Swarm then promotes derived acceptance from the scan checklists.

The contract already says an arc is per-target and can span several issues, and that the next builder reads the accepted successor lean. That MUST is on the agent. Ingest never grew a selector for the lean, a portfolio graph, or a way for a set-level bind to complete or cancel an in-flight record on a sister thread.

Umbrella ingest already refused this class: it materializes `## Current shape` so agents cannot plan from the stale body (`#1152` / `#1870`, `selectIngestCurrentShape` in `packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts`). Set-level never got the twin.

`mechanism-shaped: true`

## Measured (2026-09-01, this repo)

After a bound set-level N=3 panel on [#3953](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3953) (lean `5496071758`, synthesis `5496092560`) covering `#3953`, `#3918`, `#3849`, `#3804`, `#3764`, `#3728`, `#3626`, `#3593`:

| Issue | `task issue:ingest -- --dry-run` | Why |
|---|---|---|
| #3953, #4041 | allowed | completed-arc on **that** thread |
| #3849 | **refused** `missing-record` | leftover `design-critique:mechanism-shaped` + `role: critic` from a superseded N=1 motion; synthesis lives on #3953 |
| #3918 | allowed, would write `proposed/2026-09-01-3918-appsec-…uat-shell-residuals-babashk.xbrief.json` | `not-in-arc`; body is still the named-bin harvest |

Same dry-run session: `#4041` (a **single-issue** bound arc) is the happy path.

Parent pointer comments on the sisters (`role: parent`, “dominate into #3953”) do not change the verdict. They are not `panel-deposit`, not `role: critic`, and not a successor lean, so `isInFlightCritiqueThread` is false and ingest proceeds.

## What ingest does today

`packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts`:

- `assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` is **per issue number** (`completed-arc-record.ts` `evaluateCompletedArcRecord`). In-flight = catalog chip **or** a comment matching lean / `role: critic` / `mechanism-shaped: true` / panel-deposit. Complete = synthesis on **this** thread citing **this** thread’s latest lean.
- Overview = `composeOverviewWithComments`: body first, then every comment, with a prose note that comments “may supersede.”
- `stampDerivedClausesOnAcceptance` (`#3323`) walks `title + overviewSource`. Scan markdown checklists in the body become clauses.
- Umbrella-only: `narratives.CurrentShape` from `selectIngestCurrentShape`. No equivalent for a design-critique successor lean. A grep of the ingest module for `set-level` / `dominated` is empty.

`content/contracts/design-critique.md` `### The arc`: an arc is per-target, not per-issue, “and one arc can span several issues.” `### Target shape` set-level: “The arc anchors on one issue and takes its ceiling on that thread. … disposition is per-issue.” Bind: after the completed-arc record, ingest may proceed; “They read the accepted verified synthesis.” Clearance “cites the latest successor lean” — on the thread being ingested.

The machinery implements per-thread. The contract names spanning. That split is the defect.

## Failure mode

A swarm that ingests the open AppSec numbers after a set-level bind implements the **refused** named-bin harvest. The bound dest-based classifier, the containment split, and the MCP split never become stories unless a parent recuts bodies by hand and files new issues. `#3849` cannot be ingested at all until someone posts a second completed-arc **on #3849**, because the old critic comment can never leave `isInFlightCritiqueThread`.

The load-bearing control is parent recut / “don’t ingest sisters.” That is operator vigilance. ADR-005’s recorded failure class is that vigilance does not scale to a naive ingest.

## Not asserted — for the panel

1. Whether ingest should **select** the latest successor lean as the contract narrative (umbrella current-shape analogue), and whether derived AC should walk that narrative only.
2. Whether set-level per-issue disposition needs a **machine-readable** record ingest can fan out (dominate / split / corpus / refuse), versus remaining parent comments.
3. Whether superseding a single-issue motion from another thread must **complete or cancel** that thread’s in-flight record, or whether leftover `missing-record` is acceptable.
4. Whether a naive `issue:ingest --all` over a bound portfolio is in scope, or whether “ingest the anchor only” is the supported posture and the gap is documentation.
5. Whether splitting one bound lean into several stories is ingest’s job, `deft-directive-decompose`’s job, or operator filing.

A verdict that per-thread ingest is correct, and that set-level bind requires an explicit recut before ingest, is a legitimate outcome — but it has to be a recorded posture, not an accidental side effect of the evaluator’s thread scope.

## Non-goals

- Auto-merging eight GitHub issues into one PR
- Re-opening the #3997 dest-recovery bind or the #4041 name-gate bind
- Changing Greptile / swarm launch itself except as a consumer of ingest output
- Mechanizing lean **prose quality** (same as panel completeness: parent-binding, no parser)

## Related

- #3953 set-level bind (lean `5496071758`)
- #3849 superseded N=1 motion, ingest blocked
- #3797 arc definition and target-shape axis
- #1152 / #1870 umbrella current-shape ingest
- #3323 derived acceptance at intake
- #3806 completed-arc ingest clearance
- ADR-005 judgment gate (stamp vs mechanize judgment; recording omission)

## Origin

Filed from running the #3953 panel and then asking whether those issues were ingest-ready for a concurrent swarm.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T17:33:09Z)

model: grok-4.5
role: critic

Open critique, round 1, critic B of 3. Ceiling 5497798060. Tree at b364aa51. Did not read sibling critic posts.

Verdict
The measured split is real: the contract names spanning arcs; ingest clears and materializes per GitHub number, body-first. That split is an authorization-of-work defect for set-level bind. It must bind a machine change that stops sisters from minting the pre-bind harvest. A recorded "ingest the anchor only" posture is legitimate only if that machine gate is the posture. Docs, parent pointer comments, and "the next worker will read the lean" are vigilance and cannot be the clearance. Full lean-as-CurrentShape plus a portfolio graph is not required to close the hole; those are larger designs than the failure mode forces. Story-splitting after bind belongs to recut / decompose / operator filing, not to ingest inventing N stories from one lean.

Re-verification (live + tree)
Dry-run table re-run this session:
- #3953: allowed — DRY-RUN would write proposed/2026-09-01-3953-appsec-3-high-4-medium-41331dea-assist-scratch-in-tree-leaf.xbrief.json
- #4041: allowed — DRY-RUN would write proposed/2026-09-01-4041-secauthzhooks-appsec-scan-0e0e24bb-grok-monitor-invisible-to.xbrief.json
- #3849: refused missing-record (in flight, no completed-arc citing a local lean)
- #3918: allowed — DRY-RUN would write proposed/2026-09-01-3918-appsec-2-high-1-medium-post-3545-uat-shell-residuals-babashk.xbrief.json

Labels at re-check: #3849 still carries design-critique:mechanism-shaped; #3918 carries no design-critique catalog chip; #3953 carries design-critique:triage-ready. Sister threads carry role:parent dominate pointers (#3849 5495853803 / 5496115854; #3918 5495853868 / 5496111895). Those are not panel-deposit, not role:critic, not a successor lean.

At b364aa51:
- evaluateCompletedArcRecord / isInFlightCritiqueThread (completed-arc-record.ts): in-flight = lean heading OR role:critic OR mechanism-shaped:true OR panel-deposit; complete only when synthesis on this thread cites this thread's latest lean; else not-in-arc or missing-record.
- assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest is called per issue number; return value discarded after the throw gate.
- composeOverviewWithComments: body first, then every comment under a "may supersede" prose note — no selector for a bound lean.
- selectIngestCurrentShape materializes umbrella CurrentShape only; git grep of issue-ingest.ts for set-level / dominated / SuccessorLean is empty.
- stampDerivedClausesOnAcceptance walks title + overviewSource, so body checklists become derived acceptance on a not-in-arc sister.
- issue:ingest supports --all; blocked completed-arc holds are exit 1 in bulk, but not-in-arc sisters still write.

Inventory before new mechanism
Existing controls already on the path: completed-arc ingest gate, catalog chips (list-visible, not clearance), umbrella selectIngestCurrentShape, composeOverviewWithComments, stampDerivedClausesOnAcceptance, parent pointer comments, contract prose that agents "read the accepted verified synthesis." None of those stop #3918-class harvest after a set-level bind on another thread. Umbrella CurrentShape solved stale body on the same number; it is not a twin for cross-thread set disposition.

Classified findings

1. blocks-the-design — not-in-arc sisters mint the unbound harvest after set-level bind
Evidence: live dry-run #3918 allowed with harvest filename; #3953 synthesis 5496092560 / lean 5496071758 bound the portfolio elsewhere; #3918 has no local completed-arc and no catalog chip.
Failure mode: a swarm that ingests open portfolio numbers promotes named-bin / UAT-harvest acceptance from the sister body and builds the remedy the set-level lean refused.
Disposition consequence: any lean that keeps per-thread body ingest unchanged, or that records "ingest anchor only" without a sister refuse gate, cannot bind. The posture needs a deterministic control that makes sister harvest ingest fail closed (published reason), not an operator habit.

2. blocks-the-design — parent dominate pointers are not a clearance or a block
Evidence: isInFlightCritiqueThread ignores role:parent prose; measured #3918 still not-in-arc and allowed; contract bind text says ingest clearance cites the latest successor lean on the thread being ingested.
Failure mode: operators post "dominate into #N" and believe the portfolio is closed; ingest and --all still authorize sister harvest scope.
Disposition consequence: do not treat pointer comments, AGENTS prose, or "agents will read the lean" as the set-level post-bind control. Name a machine-readable sister state the evaluator honors (chip / cancel record / close-and-refile rule / ingest refuse reason), or require an explicit local recut completed-arc before sister ingest.

3. sharpens-framing — #3849 missing-record and #3918 harvest are opposite polarities; one fix does not cover both
Evidence: #3849 leftover critic + mechanism-shaped → permanent missing-record until a local synthesis cites a local lean; #3918 never entered that trap and mints freely.
Failure mode: binding only supersede-complete-from-anchor unsticks #3849 and still leaves #3918-class sisters open; binding only lean-as-narrative on the anchor improves #3953 reads and still leaves sister not-in-arc harvest.
Disposition consequence: answer direction 3 (supersede complete/cancel) and direction 2/4 (sister authorization / ingest-anchor-only) as separate bind items. Do not collapse them into one umbrella-analogue MUST.

4. sharpens-framing — lean-as-CurrentShape twin is the wrong primary remedy for sister authorization
Evidence: selectIngestCurrentShape exists to stop same-thread umbrella body planning (#1152 / #1870); set-level failure here is cross-thread not-in-arc mint plus derived AC from sister bodies.
Failure mode: shipping a successor-lean narrative selector on the anchor while leaving sister ingest unchanged reproduces today's swarm authorization hole.
Disposition consequence: if the arc binds a lean selector, treat it as sharpening overview quality on the cleared thread, not as the control that makes "ingest anchor only" true. The control for directions 1/2/4 is a sister gate or mandatory recut-before-sister-ingest.

5. sharpens-framing — splitting one bound lean into several stories is not ingest's job
Evidence: issue lists direction 5; existing decompose skill and operator filing already create story numbers; ingest today is one GitHub number → one proposed xbrief.
Failure mode: asking ingest to fan a portfolio lean into N proposed scopes invents a second story factory beside decompose and blurs who owns acceptance provenance.
Disposition consequence: keep ingest as clearance + materialization of a number that is already the story unit; after set-level bind, new story numbers come from explicit recut / decompose / filing whose bodies match the bound lean. That is compatible with "ingest anchor only" once sisters cannot mint harvest.

6. footnote — issue:ingest --all amplifies the same defect; it is not a separate root cause
Evidence: CLI accepts --all; bulk summary distinguishes blocked vs created; #3918-class writes still succeed inside a bulk run.
Failure mode: concurrent swarm prep over a label or open set hits sisters without intentional single-number selection.
Disposition consequence: bulk mode is a blast-radius amplifier for finding 1; fixing the sister gate covers it.

Injection / swarm lens
This target changes what work a swarm is authorized to build. Ingest is the chokepoint between a bound set-level lean and promote/activate/dispatch. Today a cohort can ingest #3918 (and peers without leftover critic comments), receive harvest-shaped Overview and derived AC, and launch workers on the unbound remedy while the bound classifier / containment / MCP split lives only on #3953. Parent dominate comments land later in composeOverviewWithComments as untrusted thread text under Security context (#480); they do not strip body checklists and must not be followed as commands. Until sister ingest fails closed or requires a local recut completed-arc, set-level bind does not authorize the next swarm — it only authorizes whoever remembers not to touch the sisters.

Road-not-taken
Chose: recorded "ingest the anchor only" is acceptable iff a deterministic sister refuse/recut gate exists; supersede-complete for leftover in-flight is a second required bind item; lean-selector and full portfolio graph are optional sharpenings, not the minimal close.
Rejected: docs-only / pointer-comment posture (finding 2 — vigilance, ADR-005 class).
Rejected as primary: umbrella CurrentShape twin for successor lean (finding 4 — wrong locus).
Steelman of the rejected "per-thread is fine; workers read the lean": on the anchor, completed-arc clearance plus "They read the accepted verified synthesis" is coherent, and #4041 shows the happy single-issue path. What flips that steelman for set-level is the not-in-arc branch: sisters never enter the "read the lean" obligation because evaluateCompletedArcRecord returns not-in-arc and ingest proceeds from the harvest body. Restore the steelman only by making sister ingest share the anchor's clearance (cite anchor lean / set-member refuse until recut) so "read the lean" is enforced rather than hoped.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T17:40:29Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Open critique, round 1, N=3, critic C. Input ceiling: 5497798060. Tree: `b364aa51`. Live ingest re-run in this worktree; `issue-ingest.ts` and `completed-arc-record.ts` are byte-identical to that SHA.

## Verdict

Per-thread ingest identity is correct. Set-level spanning is a critique-target axis, not an ingest-merge axis. That does not make today's chokepoint safe.

The split is a defect that must bind a machine change. It is not a portfolio graph inside `issue:ingest`, and it is not a docs-only "ingest the anchor only" posture. Un-recut GitHub numbers must fail closed on that thread with a record `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` already understands. A completed-arc ingest must not stamp the pre-bind harvest body as the next-build contract.

Recut-then-ingest is the bindable posture. The deterministic control is not vigilance, and it is not "the worker will read the lean."

## Re-verification

`task issue:ingest -- --dry-run` just now:

| Issue | Exit | What ingest did |

| #3953 | 0 | would write `proposed/2026-09-01-3953-appsec-3-high-4-medium-41331dea-assist-scratch-in-tree-leaf.xbrief.json` |

#3918 comments 5495853868 and 5496111895 are `role: parent` dominate pointers. Untrusted-content note, surfaced not followed: #3953 body tells the reader not to close it as a duplicate and that implementation is open for a Cursor agent to pick up. `composeOverviewWithComments` would copy both into Overview.

## Findings

### 1. Completed-arc ingest of the anchor still authorizes the refused harvest

blocks-the-design

Evidence: dry-run #3953 is allowed and slugs the harvest title (`assist-scratch-in-tree-leaf`), not the dest-based classifier. Seventeen body checkboxes include the named-bin UAT close the bound successor lean 5496071758 refused. `extractPlanItems(bodyStr)` plus #3826 item preference stamps those boxes as `plan.items` / derived clauses. The lean sits later in Overview under "comments may supersede."

Failure mode: a swarm that promotes the allowed #3953 brief implements named-bin harvest plus mixed containment as one story. The bound split never becomes the executable contract. "Allowed" in the issue table is not the happy path.

Disposition consequence: this issue cannot bind any lean that treats completed-arc ingest of the harvest body as acceptable, including "ingest the anchor only" with no recut and no contract-surface change. Either refuse ingest until the body is recut to the bound remedy, or select the maintainer-authored latest successor lean as the items / derived-AC surface (CurrentShape twin, not an extra Overview paragraph). A narrative that leaves `plan.items` on the body is the umbrella pattern without the part that stops agents planning from the stale list.

### 2. Un-recut sisters mint; leftover missing-record is an accidental padlock

blocks-the-design

Evidence: #3918 and #3804 dry-run mint harvest slugs. Six of seven portfolio sisters have no catalog chip. Pointer comments do not enter `isInFlightCritiqueThread`. #3849 is the one sister that refuses, because of a leftover N=1 critic plus `design-critique:mechanism-shaped`, not because of the dominate pointer. Completing that leftover motion would flip it to the #3918 path: `complete` is ingest-allow (`assertCompletedArcAllowsIngest` throws only on `blocked`). Closing a sister would drop it from `--all` and would not stop `issue:ingest -- 3918`.

Failure mode: naive ingest of open AppSec numbers after the #3953 bind ships the unbound harvest. The one padlocked sister cannot be recut-ingested without a second completed-arc on #3849, and that second record would mint the harvest unless finding 1 is also bound. ADR-005's recorded failure class is vigilance against a naive ingest.

Disposition consequence: "ingest the anchor only" as documentation cannot bind. Recut-then-ingest can bind only if every un-recut member is fail-closed on that thread by a record the evaluator already reads (catalog chip or in-flight comment leading to missing-record). Parent must write that record at bind. Pointer prose is not it. Do not complete a superseded sister in order to ingest it. Dominate stays refuse-terminal until a recut body (or a newly filed issue) is the thing being ingested.

### 3. Do not put a set-level graph inside ingest

sharpens-framing

Evidence: contract target-shape already says the arc anchors on one issue, takes its ceiling there, and dispositions per-issue. `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` takes one comments array. Decompose's job is an approved parent xBRIEF, operator-gated, not eight harvest numbers. Lean 5496071758's bound output is three stories (UAT root, containment, MCP), which are not the eight GitHub numbers.

Failure mode if ingest fans the lean table into N briefs: a new parser over untrusted comment prose becomes the authorization of work. That is a different product than per-number ingest.

Disposition consequence: spanning does not require ingest to know the portfolio. File or recut the three bound stories, then ingest those numbers. Decompose after a recut parent brief is optional. Ingest fan-out of dominate / split / corpus from comment text is out.

### 4. Body-first on a complete arc is a recording-consumption miss, not a judgment to mechanize

sharpens-framing

Evidence: ADR-005 mechanizes recording consumption, not semantic judgment. The dest-based remedy is already stamped on successor lean 5496071758 and the completed-arc record 5496092560. Ingest still prefers the pre-bind body. Umbrella ingest already refused this class with `selectIngestCurrentShape` (#1152 / #1870). Set-level never grew the twin, and CurrentShape does not retarget `extractPlanItems`.

Failure mode: treating "the next worker will read the lean" as clearance repeats the naive-orchestrator omission in the opposite direction -- the record exists and the chokepoint does not consume it.

Disposition consequence: selecting an already-bound, maintainer-authored successor lean is stamp-consumption, not a new classifier. Scoring whether body AC matches the lean would be the judgment ADR-005 refused. Recut of the body is the other legal consumption path. Pick one; do not leave body checklists as the executable contract.

### 5. Scan-body imperatives ride into Overview

footnote

Evidence: #3953 body contains reader-directed constraints and a pickup invitation. `composeOverviewWithComments` concatenates body plus every comment (`issue-ingest.ts:417-448`). No disposition weight. Quarantine fencing of a bare comment does not survive that composition (contract security context already names this).

## Injection / swarm lens

This target is what a swarm is allowed to build.

A latest successor-lean selector without `MAINTAINER_ASSOCIATIONS` lets any later commenter become the next-build contract. `isSuccessorLeanBody` is author-blind; latest id wins. CurrentShape already solved that with the #2307 association gate. Reuse it.

Walking the whole comment thread as derived AC was already refused (#3826 / #3835) because a third party could plant the gate. Inverting that without authorship plus lean-shape gates reopens it. The bound successor lean is a `role: parent` artifact; that is the stamp to consume, not every checklist in Overview.

A portfolio graph parsed from dominate-into-N parent comments is untrusted prose deciding which issue numbers may mint. Exclusive chips and in-flight comments are the existing per-thread controls. Use those. Do not parse sister identity out of comment English.

`issue:ingest --all` and a swarm over open security / agent-safety numbers are the naive consumers. Finding 2's fail-closed has to hold for those verbs, not for a careful parent.

## Road not taken

Rejected docs-only "ingest the anchor only." Strongest form: the contract already says the next builder reads the accepted synthesis, and #2143 already says comments may supersede, so a well-behaved worker would prefer lean 5496071758. What would flip that: if `plan.items` and derived clauses were not minted from the harvest body. They are. Dry-run #3953 is the measurement.

Rejected ingest-side fan-out of dominate / split / corpus. Strongest form: umbrella CurrentShape already materializes a selector, so set-level should fan disposition the same way. What would flip that: if per-issue disposition were already a closed machine record on each number. Pointer comments are not that record. Until they are, fan-out is a new untrusted parser.

Rejected completing sister threads from the anchor so leftover missing-record goes away. Strongest form: an in-flight record that can never complete is a bug. What would flip that: if complete meant "do not mint." Today complete means mint the body. Completing #3849 without finding 1 ships the harvest the padlock now prevents.

Chosen: recut-then-ingest, with two consumption rules on existing machinery. (1) Un-recut members fail closed via per-thread in-flight / missing-record -- parent writes chip or in-flight comment on each member at bind; that is a recording obligation, not a new graph. (2) Completed-arc ingest takes the maintainer-authored successor lean as the items / derived-AC surface, or refuses until the body is recut. Splitting the bound three stories is operator filing or decompose of a recut parent, not ingest.


### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-01T17:42:18Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Open critique, round 1, critic A of 3. Ceiling: comment 5497798060. Tree: `b364aa51`.

The spanning-vs-per-thread split is an authorization defect. It must bind a machine change. It must not bind a CurrentShape twin that selects the successor lean as the next-build contract, and it must not bind a docs-only "ingest the anchor only" posture.

Per-thread ingest (one GitHub number to one xbrief, body-scoped AC) is the correct mapper if and only if set-level bind also records a fail-closed dominate/cancel that ingest consumes, and the stories the bind actually wants are filed or recut as bodies before ingest. Without that control, "the next worker will read the lean" is vigilance. ADR-005 already recorded that class.

## Re-verification

Live `task issue:ingest -- <N> --dry-run` on 2026-09-01 against this worktree. SHA for source cites: `b364aa51`.

## 1. Sister harvest mint — `blocks-the-design`

Evidence: live dry-run #3918 and #3804 allowed; filenames from harvest titles; no catalog chip. Parent dominate comments 5496111895 and 5496115854 are `role: parent` and fail `isInFlightCritiqueThread`. `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` therefore returns `not-in-arc` and `ingestOne` builds from that issue's body (`issue-ingest.ts:983-993`).

Disposition: bind cannot be "sisters need no machine change" and cannot be "ingest the anchor only" as prose. Must bind a record `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` consumes so dominate numbers fail closed. ## Injection / swarm lens

This target is the chokepoint between a bound set-level lean and what a swarm is authorized to build. The lens fires.

- Authority. Ingest output is the next-build contract. `not-in-arc` on a dominated sister authorizes the refused harvest. `--all` over still-open #3918 / #3804 / #3849 / #3953 is the naive orchestrator ADR-005 named (`docs/decisions/ADR-005-design-critique-judgment-gate.md:54`).

Harvest bodies become `plan.items` and Overview. #3849's critic already surfaced reader-directed imperatives in the scan body. `composeOverviewWithComments` concatenates harvest body + dominate comments into one Overview (compositional fragments). Derived AC prefers body checklists, so the untrusted scan AC wins over the parent lean.
- Direction 1 without #2307. Author-blind latest-lean selector becomes the contract. CurrentShape already refused non-maintainer shape.
- Direction 1 walking the lean for AC. Reopens #3794 / #3819 (comment-thread acceptance headings becoming the gate). #3826 exists to prevent that.
- Concurrency / shared state. Chips and in-flight comments are per-thread. Set-level bind wrote `triage-ready` on the anchor only. Sisters share no completed-arc state.
- Worktrees. Once harvest xbriefs exist in `proposed/`, promote/activate is the next step. The defect is upstream of launch.

Do not close any of this with reviewer attention. The dry-run already is the naive ingest.

## Road-not-taken

Chose among: (A) docs-only ingest-anchor-only, (B) CurrentShape twin that selects the lean, (C) auto fan-out of a portfolio graph into N xbriefs, (D) per-thread ingest plus a machine-consumed dominate/cancel and recut-before-ingest of story numbers.

Took D.

Steelman of A: the contract already says they read the synthesis; 1:1 ingest stays simple; parent recuts by hand. What would flip it: sister ingest fail-closed and the anchor body recut so `plan.items` match the bind. Today neither holds (#3918 / #3804 mint; #3953 checkboxes still live).

Steelman of B: umbrella solved stale-body with a selector. What would flip it: the lean had a maintainer plus discriminator selector, and derived AC could walk it without inverting #3826, and sisters were still blocked. The first two collide with existing injection controls. The third is D's block, not B's selector.

Steelman of C: one bind should produce the dest / containment / MCP stories. What would flip it: ingest became decompose (approval gate, file_scope, traces). That is a different skill. The closed catalog has no dominate chip to mint from.

1. Do not select the successor lean as the contract narrative, and do not walk it for derived AC. Recut the body (or file a new issue). #3826 is the reason.
2. Yes: a machine-readable dominate/cancel ingest already knows how to refuse. Not a graph that auto-mints stories. Parent comments are not that record.
3. Leftover `missing-record` is not acceptable. Supersede must complete or cancel.
4. "Ingest the anchor only" is not the supported posture while the anchor is still a harvest body. The recorded posture is: ingest recut story issues only. The deterministic control is D above, not a docs patch.
5. Splitting one bound lean into dest / containment / MCP stories is operator filing or decompose after a recut parent xbrief. It is not ingest of the harvest numbers.
